part: 1 - reasoning during the VeilLens protection loop
why: No VeilLens protection run covers this image set. The largest Cityscapes geolocation run on disk is 100 images (pipeline2/result/test_iter3), and those 100 ids are a subset of these 500. Its reasoning is already archived, in full, at results/geolocation_100/. Runs of 217 and 200 images exist but are on other image sets or other configurations, and none of them extends past the 100 ids shared with this set.
consequence: Nothing in this folder measures VeilLens itself on 500 images. Everything here is the GPT Image 2 baseline and the unprotected reference.
